paragraphs: A full-stack ERP for a manufacturing plant (workforce, inventory, orders, production, reports, analytics) with an integrated CCTV AI. The AI detects fights, falls, fire/smoke, crowding and unusual activity, and turns each event into one incident with evidence. The incident appears live on every open dashboard.
Final-year project. All model numbers below come from docs/RESULTS.md, generated from the training metrics files.
features: ERP: employees, shifts and attendance; materials, stock and scrap;

client and purchase orders; production work orders; reports; audit trail; role-based access for 8 roles plus a service role; a My Profile page where every user edits their name and phone and changes their password.
Smart Analytics: demand forecasting (Holt / Croston–SBA), dynamic
reorder points, ABC-XYZ, stock-anomaly detection, an OEE-style index with SPC charts, a supplier scorecard, and a Plant Health Index.
CCTV AI, one model per incident type (YOLO finds and tracks people;
